sources.tier3: Park Shark Tier 3: gradient boosted quantile regression (scikit-learn HistGradientBoostingRegressor, 10th/50th/90th percentile) blended with a campus template
sources.tier3Note: Learned from public car parks in Birmingham (UK) and The Hague (NL). No Duke readings used yet. On the most campus-like public lots it beat the hour x weekday average by 44% (MAE 0.129 vs 0.231). Live sensor readings replace these estimates when present.
